name: netskope
label: Netskope
description: Netskope provides smart cloud security which controls activities across any cloud service or website and provides 360-degree data and threat protection that works everywhere. This connector facilitates automated operations like get alerts list, get events list, and urls related operations.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.description: Specify the server URL to connect and perform the automated operations.
fields.tooltip: Specify the server URL to connect and perform the automated operations.
fields.name: server_url

fields.title: API Token
fields.description: Specify the API token to connect and perform the automated operations.
fields.tooltip: Specify the API token to connect and perform the automated operations.
fields.name: api_token

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.

operations.title: Get Alerts List
operations.description: Retrieves a detailed list of alerts based on the query, alert type, and other filter criteria that you have specified.

parameters.title: Query
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a query to filter the records retrieved from Netskope.

parameters.title: Alert Type
parameters.description: (Optional) Select the alert type to filter the records retrieved from Netskope. You can choose from the following options: Anomaly, Compromised Credential, Policy, Legal Hold, Malsite, etc.
parameters.tooltip: Select the alert type to filter the records retrieved from Netskope. You can choose from the following options: Anomaly, Compromised Credential, Policy, Legal Hold, Malsite, etc.

operations.title: Create URL List
operations.description: Creates an URL blocked-list in Netskope based on the list name, list type, and the URLs that you have specified.

parameters.title: URL List Name
parameters.description: Specify the name of the list to create the URL blocked-list in Netskope.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the list to create the URL blocked-list in Netskope.
parameters.name: name

parameters.title: URL List Type
parameters.description: Specify the format for entering URLs in the URLs parameter. Possible values are exact and regex.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the format for entering URLs in the URLs parameter. Possible values are exact and regex.
parameters.name: type

parameters.title: URLs
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of URLs — if the URL List Type is exact — and specify a comma-separated list of regex — if the URL List Type is regex — to create the URL blocked-list in Netskope.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of URLs — if the URL List Type is exact — and specify a comma-separated list of regex — if the URL List Type is regex — to create the URL blocked-list in Netskope.
parameters.name: urls

operations.title: Get All URL List
operations.description: Retrieves a detailed list of URL blocked-list based on the pending and comma-separated field parameters that you have specified.

parameters.title: Pending
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify to filter and retrieve URL blocked-lists from Netskope based on their processing status. • Specify 1 to retrieve URL lists that are awaiting approval or processing. • Specify 0 to retrieve lists that have been fully processed or finalized
parameters.tooltip: Specify to filter and retrieve URL blocked-lists from Netskope based on their processing status. • Specify 1 to retrieve URL lists that are awaiting approval or processing. • Specify 0 to retrieve lists that have been fully processed or finalized
parameters.name: pending

parameters.title: Field
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify comma-separated list of fields to filter and retrieve URL blocked-lists from Netskope.
parameters.tooltip: Specify comma-separated list of fields to filter and retrieve URL blocked-lists from Netskope.
parameters.name: field

operations.title: Get URL List Details
operations.description: Retrieves a detailed for specific URL blocked-list based on the URL list ID that you have specified.

parameters.title: URL List ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the URL blocked-list whose details you want to retrieve details from Netskope.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the URL blocked-list whose details you want to retrieve details from Netskope.
parameters.name: url_list_id

operations.title: Add URL List
operations.description: Appends a URL blocked-list in Netskope based on the URL list ID, list type, and URLs that you have specified.

parameters.title: URL List ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the URL blocked-list in which to append the URLs for blocking in Netskope.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the URL blocked-list in which to append the URLs for blocking in Netskope.
parameters.name: url_list_id

parameters.title: URL List Type
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the format for entering URLs in the URLs parameter. Possible values are exact and regex.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the format for entering URLs in the URLs parameter. Possible values are exact and regex.
parameters.name: type

parameters.title: URLs
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of URLs — if the URL List Type is exact — and specify a comma-separated list of regex — if the URL List Type is regex — to append the URLs to this URL list in Netskope.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of URLs — if the URL List Type is exact — and specify a comma-separated list of regex — if the URL List Type is regex — to append the URLs to this URL list in Netskope.
parameters.name: urls

operations.title: Apply Pending URL Changes
operations.description: Applies all pending URL list changes that have been staged, making them active in your tenant.

operations.description: Updates a URL blocked-list in Netskope based on the URL list ID, list type, and URLs that you have specified.

parameters.title: URL List ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the URL blocked-list in which to update the URLs for blocking in Netskope.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the URL blocked-list in which to update the URLs for blocking in Netskope.

parameters.title: URL List Name

parameters.tooltip: Specify the name of the list to update in Netskope.

parameters.title: URL List Type
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the format for entering URLs in the URLs parameter. Possible values are exact and regex.
parameters.tooltip: Specify the format for entering URLs in the URLs parameter. Possible values are exact and regex.
parameters.name: type

parameters.title: URLs
parameters.description: Specify a comma-separated list of URLs — if the URL List Type is exact — and specify a comma-separated list of regex — if the URL List Type is regex — with which to replace the existing URL list in Netskope.
parameters.tooltip: Specify a comma-separated list of URLs — if the URL List Type is exact — and specify a comma-separated list of regex — if the URL List Type is regex — with which to replace the existing URL list in Netskope.

operations.title: Execute an API Request
operations.description: Sends an API request to any API endpoint based on specified HTTP method, endpoint, and other input parameters that you have specified, enabling flexible API interactions tailored to user needs.

parameters.name: method
parameters.title: HTTP Method
parameters.description:
Select an HTTP action for the request. You can select from the following options:  

DELETE 

GET 

PATCH 

POST 

PUT

parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Specify the target API URL path for the request. For example, if the website is https://example.com and URL path is https://example.com/api/v2/incidents/search, the endpoint would be /api/v2/incidents/search.
parameters.description: Specify the target API URL path for the request. For example, if the website is https://example.com and URL path is https://example.com/api/v2/incidents/search, the endpoint would be /api/v2/incidents/search.

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.name: query_params
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify any optional parameters to add to the URL and refine the request.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.title: Request Payload
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify data, as JSON, to be sent as the request payload (typically for POST or PUT requests).
